rubric_notes: Complete, bundle-verified enumeration of a.22.1.1-4 and a.22.1.0 with sunids, comments and Pfam xref; homology endpoint cited correctly. Family vs superfamily distinction preserved; states superfamily asserts probable common origin but not identical function, oligomeric state or DNA binding for TAF/NC2/NF-Y/CHRAC/Sos/archaeal/bacterial members. Correctly handles linker histones as different fold with no homology assertion and modifying enzymes as unrelated. Limits explicitly stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Correct lineages and sunids, release metadata supported by bundle. Clearly states superfamily-level probable common ancestry, not family-level and not analogy, and that fold/class add only architectural similarity. Explicitly rejects transfer of HisE substrate/pathway to the hypothetical SSo12199 and MazG activity to HisE, plus ligand, template, oligomeric and genomic-context transfers. External evidence listed. No material errors.

Correct families, superfamily, fold, class, sunids, domain splits (d4foea1/2, d1r59o1/2, d1rgia1/2), duplication comment, and homology flags all verified in bundle. Identifies superfamily as deepest homology-bearing node, infers common origin and conserved duplicated core with nucleotide site at the lobe interface, and explicitly denies transfer of substrate, ATP hydrolysis vs binding, catalytic/substrate residues, oligomeric state, regulation, and atomic-level templates; fold-level similarity not equated with homology or non-homology; automated-match provenance noted. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete: correct families, sunids, protein members, comments, and homology flags all supported by bundle; interprets as functional divergence from a common ancestral metal-binding scaffold and explicitly rejects convergence and functional equivalence readings; detailed unsafe-transfer list, template caveats, correct asymmetric statement on other a.25 superfamilies, and external evidence named. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Verified lineage for d1iuza_, d1ikop_, d5n0ya1 to b.6.1; family codes, sunids, Pfam, annotations and fold warning match bundle. Remote homology stated at correct strength; copper/ET transfer refused with ligand-set, crystallographic/spectroscopic and assay evidence required; template and limits sections appropriate. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Families, sunids, Pfam xrefs, fold core annotation (beta(2)-alpha-beta(2), sheet 2143), homology flags, d1h8ca_/d2c5ld_ annotations (automated match, GTP/Mg complex) and empty search result all verified in bundle. Minor unverifiable member names (SUMO-3, Ubl3/5/7) only.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Thorough and fully bundle-supported: families, sunids, species, UniProt Q79PF6, domain ids, KaiA C-terminal a.186.1.1, ODC major (c.67.1.5) and C-terminal (d.125.1.1) domains, and the fold-level 'homology_not_implied_above_superfamily' warning. Articulates superfamily-strength divergent homology, rejects transfer of phosphoacceptor chemistry, decarboxylase activity, and circadian regulation in both directions, and notes the single-species ODC wing family and automated Pfam mapping as limits.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Comprehensive and verified: lineage with sunids, five superfamilies with comments, homology endpoint results, family/protein/species nodes, example domains, 3gqb domain layout showing the bulge as insertion in discontinuous c.37.1.11 and absence from B subunit, 1.75 baseline with four superfamilies, 2.06 creation. Correctly states positive family-level homology, fold-level-only relation to b.84.1-b.84.4, and that separate superfamily is absence of a positive homology assertion, not a claim of convergence. Family vs superfamily and unsafe transfers handled. Minor looseness lumping b.84.2/b.84.3 under 'biotin/lipoate carrying' in the limits paragraph, not a classification error.

Correct three-superfamily hierarchy with sunids, families, and example NarI domains all supported by bundle; homology endpoint correctly interpreted; states separate superfamilies are not proof of convergence; cites curator 'possible link'; names external evidence (profile-HMM/Pfam clan, structure alignment with ligand correspondence, phylogenetics). Complete.

Correct family/superfamily/fold/class identifiers and sunids, correct 13-family count, correct observation that c.2.1 is the only superfamily under c.2, family comments and PF02254 all supported by the bundle; the b.35.1.2 N-terminal partner lineage is supported by the 50136 parents call. Interpretation correctly separates family-level (not shared), superfamily-level (probable common ancestry) and fold-level claims, states that different families are not evidence of non-homology, and rejects cross-family transfer of ligand, catalysis, zinc sites, gating role and templates. States verification limits clearly. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete: same family k.40.1.1 (sunid 100905), 'not a true family' comment identified as the override of the generic homology flag, class k context, fold/class warnings and ligand notes all supported by bundle. Calibrated statement of what SCOPe does and does not assert, plus unsafe transfers and external evidence needs. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14. Most thorough: 1.69 lineages verified including fold comment (4-stranded sheet) and the fact that c.23.14 held one family in 1.69; 2.08 d1t1ja1 c.23.14.2 vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1 with four-family superfamily listing verified; 1.71 and 1.73 c.23.14.2 verified (1.75 claim consistent). Interprets the move as fold abolition plus re-parenting of the preserved family sunid, i.e. a new superfamily-level homology hypothesis, and links the 'lacks the last strand' comment to why it was originally a separate fold. Clearly separates class l tag split as boundary-only. Limits on function transfer, template use, and unexposed curator rationale are stated. Correct current SID.

Complete: correct lineage and sunids for both segments, cites homology endpoint (homology_implied_by_level=false, artifact_not_homology_evidence warning) and annotations, explains class-l family/superfamily as administrative bins, enumerates unsafe transfers to avoid, states limits. All claims supported by bundle.

Correctly gives the 1.75 whole-chain d1acca_ (43828, f.11.1.1), the two 2.08 domains with exact sunids and boundaries, and dates the split to 2.04 with persistence through 2.08. Interprets the split as recognition of a reusable module via the populated PA14-like superfamily versus the singleton C-terminal superfamily, restricts transfer to the matching region, refuses substrate and mechanism transfer from superfamily placement, and correctly treats different classes as absence of a homology assertion rather than evidence of analogy. States limits on rationale, periodic updates, and quality data.

Correct decomposition with SIDs, boundaries, lineages, sibling families, and release context (present in 2.07, fold absent in 1.75). Mosaic interpretation distinguishes reused superfamily modules, family-level bromodomain, and the new fold; function-transfer caveats and boundary/linker limits stated. No material errors.

Complete: shared family a.298.1.1, correct lineage and sunids, retrieved lengths 51/373/752, the 're' code with its definition read as curatorial expectation rather than error, and the canonical repeat unit with per-node coordinate scope handled correctly. Repeat counts are explicitly labeled as the answerer's arithmetic, avoiding any assumption of identical counts. Strong level-by-level homology strength, named per-entity treatment including the cross-genus BurrH placement, enumerated unsafe transfers, and quality/representative caveats without treating the repeat representative as a quality ranking. Only blemish is a self-corrected handedness phrase. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

All reported release metadata matches the /releases/current evidence. Cites stable 2.08 selector, states periodic update does not replace stable, and requires recording the exact dated periodic label when depending on periodic-only records. Periodic semantics (dated incremental additions without changing stable hierarchy) correct; endpoint limits stated.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Bundle-verified lineage, ms flags (absent in 1.75), fold homology warning, 1dn1 obsolete with sunid change to automated match, d3c98b_ unflagged under curated node, revisions record. Interpretation: fold placement inherited through family membership, three-helix fragment resembles spectrin so structure-only comparison could mislead, the unflagged full domain is what supports the a.47 assignment, family co-membership is the strongest relationship claim without function transfer; consequences for benchmarks, representative choice (AEROSPACI alone would pick the fragment) and template use. Limits explicit.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Two-level interpretation (divergence within c.2.1, no positive assertion across c.2/c.3/c.4/c.31/c.82/d.58.20) with explicit caveat that separate folds are not proof of independent origin; clear explanation of why cofactor/active-site similarity is weak (low information, convergence where function is strongest, converse failure within c.2.1); detailed evidence needed to upgrade or refute homology. All sunids, family lists, comments and homology-endpoint values match the bundle.

Correctly contrasts class-only sharing in 2.04 under folds b.23 versus b.18 with shared superfamily b.18.1 and separate families b.18.1.36 and b.18.1.3 in 2.08. Gives full lineages with matching sunids, the retired b.23.2 node, and the chain B boundary/artifact correction. Supplies three evidence types: curated PubMed 17977833 homology note linking the collagenase domain to a delta-endotoxin C-terminal sibling, jelly-roll beta-sandwich topology, and shared accessory targeting-module role, with the bridging-intermediate argument for why the link surfaced after 2.04. Rejects ligand, calcium, catalytic and template transfer and correctly notes a 2.04 different-fold placement is not evidence of analogy. Only leaves the exact transition release unpinned, which it states.

All bundle facts correct; extra PDB titles and quality values consistent with public records and correctly framed (AEROSPACI as technical quality only). Homology preserved at family/protein/species level; hf explained as structural heterogeneity with a.4 label inherited; rejects template and a.4-positive use; recommends exclude or stratify with hf label preserved; notes leakage/near-identity; does not claim 1p7j contains DNA. Limits stated.

All facts match bundle: release metadata, lineage sunids, fr heterogeneity (domain scope, non-inherited), d1o5dt1 and d2hfta2 unflagged, 1uc6/1o5d quality and domain lists, d1uc6a1 sole member of its species node. Correctly states the flag is a completeness caveat not an ancestry caveat, partial-coverage alignment with coverage reported relative to the complete domain, fragment masked in profile building, AEROSPACI must not override the fr flag, the two domains do not compete for a representative slot, unflagged domain-2 siblings preferred after quality retrieval, fragments excluded/stratified or kept with label, no function transfer. Honest limits on missing-residue identity and unretrieved sibling quality. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

Recommends new superfamily in existing fold; correctly states family = positive probable-homology claim within superfamily, new fold = distinct core topology (structural, not evolutionary claim), and superfamily split as asymmetric 'no homology asserted' rather than analogy/convergence. Frames placement as a curated, revisable hypothesis requiring integrated evidence (sequence, motifs, architecture, phylogeny); rejects function/template transfer; notes nf/hf annotations and manual curation. Release facts (2.08, 2.08-stable, 2021-09-22, 2.08-2026-08-16) supported by /releases/current bundle. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

All classifications, sunids, comments, homology flags and release facts correct and bundle-supported.
